key.name: space-counts
key.summary: Number of normal spaces per monitor (key = monitor geometry WxH+X+Y)

key.name: default-spaces
key.summary: Spaces for a monitor seen for the first time

key.name: maximize-to-new-space
key.summary: Maximized windows get their own space (fullscreen always does)

key.name: panel-on-all-monitors
key.summary: Show a top bar with spaces indicator and clock on every monitor

key.name: debug-log
key.summary: Also log every space switch (verbose) to ~/.local/state/per-screen-workspaces/extension.log

key.name: add-space
key.summary: Add a space on the monitor under the pointer

key.name: remove-space
key.summary: Remove the current space on the monitor under the pointer
